title: No: she wouldn’t like that much. Got her it once.
html_source: Ostensibly, Bloom is seeking a romantic and/or erotic book for Molly, though he seems more than a little interested in them himself.

anchor.text: No: she wouldn't like that much. Got her it once.
anchor.prefix:
itles. Fair Tyrants by James Lovebirch. Know the kind that is. Had it? Yes. 

1961#235

 He opened it. Thought so. 

 A woman's voice behind the dingy curtain. Listen: the man.
anchor.suffix:
He read the other title: Sweets of Sin. More in her line. Let us see. 

 He read where his finger opened. 

— All the dollarbills her husband gave her were spent in the stores
